summary.text: Ragen Hatcher is a Democratic state representative who represents Indiana House District 3, has served since 2018, and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Ragen Hatcher received a B.A. in economics and a master's degree in administration from Valparaiso University, and a master's degree in finance from Indiana University, where she also taught urban studies.
She served as a Lake County deputy prosecutor and on the Gary City Council from 2007 to 2015, and her other work experience includes being an attorney.
Hatcher assumed office on November 7, 2018, succeeding Charlie Brown, and advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.
She is the only candidate listed for District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
For 2025-2026, she was assigned to the Agriculture and Rural Development, Financial Institutions and Insurance, and Government and Regulatory Reform committees.
